## Before requesting review

- [ ] Tests cover the change.
- [ ] The branch is based on the latest `main` and follows the `fix/`, `feat/`, `docs/` or `chore/` convention.
- [ ] A change to a window, toolbar, popover, notification or widget includes a screenshot.
- [ ] Any document this change invalidates is updated in the same pull request.
